nav_timeout_s.provenance: carried over unchanged from the NAV_TIMEOUT_S constant of browser_fetch.py (author's choice, never measured). Per-navigation Playwright timeout in seconds

idle_timeout_s.provenance: carried over unchanged from the IDLE_TIMEOUT_S constant of browser_fetch.py (author's choice, never measured). Extra wait in seconds for a JS challenge or a reader page to reach network idle; such pages often never do, so the wait is bounded

human_window_s.provenance: chosen 2026-11-05, PROVISIONAL and unmeasured. Replaces the 45 s ASSIST_WAIT_S of browser_fetch.py. Window in seconds, headed mode only, for the owner to approve an MFA prompt and click the Cloudflare Turnstile checkbox that real Chrome 157 shows on ScienceDirect (measured 2026-11-05). Polling stops the instant a PDF is captured. To be revised from the first live run (plan 2 step 8) once the UQAC sign-in is known to ask for a push or a TOTP code

headless_wait_s.provenance: carried over unchanged from the literal 3 in browser_fetch.py (author's choice, never measured). Polling budget in seconds when the browser is headless, where no human can intervene

poll_s.provenance: carried over unchanged from the POLL_S constant of browser_fetch.py (author's choice, never measured). Seconds between two checks for a captured PDF

popup_wait_s.provenance: carried over unchanged from the literal 8000 ms in browser_fetch.py (author's choice, never measured). Seconds to wait for a viewer popup after clicking a PDF control

viewer_settle_s.provenance: carried over unchanged from the literal 2500 ms in browser_fetch.py (author's choice, never measured). Seconds a PDF viewer is given to stream its file after it opens

download_wait_s.provenance: carried over unchanged from the literal 15000 ms in browser_fetch.py (author's choice, never measured). Seconds to wait for a download after clicking a Download control

download_retry_pause_s.provenance: carried over unchanged from the literal 1500 ms in browser_fetch.py (author's choice, never measured). Pause in seconds after a download click that streamed the PDF as a response instead

step_timeout_s.provenance: chosen 2026-11-05, PROVISIONAL and unmeasured. Seconds Playwright waits for a login form field or button to appear before a sign-in step is reported as failed. To be revised from the first live run

max_pdf_bytes.provenance: carried over unchanged from the MAX_PDF_BYTES constant of browser_fetch.py: 100 MiB, matching MAX_PDF_BYTES of download_pdf.py (author's choice, never measured)

channel.provenance: chosen by the owner 2026-11-05. The installed Google Chrome gets an interactive Turnstile checkbox on ScienceDirect that a human can click (measured 2026-11-05, Chrome 157), while the bundled Chromium never clears the interstitial (measured 2026-09-17). null selects the bundled Chromium. When Chrome is not installed the module falls back to the bundled Chromium and logs that it did

profile_dir.provenance: carried over unchanged from the BROWSER_PROFILE_DIR constant of browser_fetch.py. Persistent browser profile, expanded with the user's home directory. It holds session cookies for the owner's institutional access, so it must stay outside any repository

user_agent.provenance: chosen 2026-11-05. The former BROWSER_UA forced Chrome/124 and would contradict the real Chrome 157 the channel now launches, whose client hints state the true version. null leaves the browser's own user agent untouched. A string sets it for the bundled Chromium

secret_provider.provenance: owner ruling 2026-11-05: pluggable secret provider, keyring (the operating system store) by default, bitwarden for the owner's own use, keepassxc as the third. Password only, never a TOTP secret unless allow_totp_from_vault is true

allow_totp_from_vault.provenance: owner ruling 2026-11-05: the password only is read from a vault by default and the human approves MFA. true lets a host step read a one-time code from the same vault, which puts both factors in one place, so a warning is logged each time it is used

provider_timeout_s.provenance: chosen 2026-11-05, PROVISIONAL and unmeasured (R10). Seconds before a call to a secret provider's command line tool is abandoned and reported as a timeout

challenge_title_markers.provenance: chosen 2026-11-05, PROVISIONAL: lower-case fragments of the page title that Cloudflare's challenge and block pages carry ("Just a moment..." is the managed-challenge interstitial). While the title holds one of them, a headed run keeps waiting for the owner to clear the challenge, up to human_window_s. To be confirmed against the live ScienceDirect run

challenge_selectors.provenance: chosen 2026-11-05, PROVISIONAL: CSS selectors present while a Cloudflare Turnstile widget is on the page (the widget is served from challenges.cloudflare.com). Same use as challenge_title_markers. To be confirmed against the live ScienceDirect run

hosts.provenance: empty on purpose 2026-11-05. A publisher host gets an entry only after a live run has verified its institutional sign-in (plan 2 step 8, UQAC SSO on ScienceDirect), because an entry URL or selector written offline would be an invented value (R14). A host that is not listed keeps the flow without sign-in. Each entry: entry_url (https), login_hosts (bare host names, the only pages a password or one-time code may be typed into, checked before the secret is read: added after the security review of 2026-11-05 so a redirect chain cannot lead a secret to a look-alike page), username_env (name of the environment variable holding the user name, never the name itself), vault_item (item the secret provider looks up), steps (a list of {action, selector} with action one of fill_username, fill_password, fill_totp, click) and logged_in_selector (a CSS selector present only once signed in)
